the development of interventions that reduce children's exposure to violence and the impact of that violence on children's mental health.
the effects of intimate partner violence (IPV) on children and the effects of interventions designed to reduce children's conduct problems.
the effects of domestic violence on child adjustment, and with the effects of interventions to prevent or reduce the adverse effects of domestic violence exposure.
